# Student Performance Analytics

> Decision-support workspace for academic performance and placement readiness.
> The exam-score and placement datasets are independent and share no student
> identifier. Models are experimental; no production accuracy is claimed.

## Product

- `/` — single-page workspace with six views: Overview, Academic Performance,
  Placement Readiness, Student Insights, Recommendations, Model Insights.
- `/api/health` — artifact and model readiness.
- `/api/prediction-schema` — field names, labels, ranges, and allowed values
  shared by the API, training scripts, and web forms.

## Prediction endpoints

- `POST /api/predict/exam` — JSON body with the exam-track fields from
  `/api/prediction-schema`. Returns a bounded score, an approximate ±1 RMSE
  band, limitations, and advisory prompts.
- `POST /api/predict/placement` — JSON body with the placement-track fields.
  Returns the model output at a 0.5 threshold. The placement label is
  deterministic in the synthetic source, so high scores are a dataset artifact.
- `POST /api/interventions` — optional subset of numeric fields; returns
  transparent advisory prompts, never a prediction.

## Evidence endpoints

- `/api/summary`, `/api/metrics`, `/api/model-performance`
- `/api/cross-validation`, `/api/overfitting`
- `/api/feature-importance`, `/api/leakage`, `/api/placement-investigation`
- `/api/data-quality`, `/api/pca`, `/api/clusters`, `/api/fairness`

## Reproduction

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python scripts/run_pipeline.py
python app.py
```

## Limitations

- Both source datasets are synthetic.
- The placement label is derivable from four features; near-perfect scores
  describe dataset construction.
- Clusters and group error comparisons are descriptive, not causal or fair-use
  certifications.
